summary: the coherence review before 1.0: discovery sign-off, required checks, who tells the App Creator and model wording no longer contradict each other across the template, the core skills and the modules
appCreator: In discovery, a document's pull request now clearly waits for your approval even when its checks are green, a late approval is merged by a new thread, and research studies do not wait.
The coordinator names the next discovery document in one line and starts its thread only when you say yes; an instruction that already names the work counts as that yes.
Test scripts, plans and questions reach you in the thread that produced them; the coordinator only points to the thread (build-feature, release, migrate-app and new-app said otherwise).
The architecture handoff is reviewed on the review model instead of starting the strongest model without being asked, and it no longer needs app-studio beside the app.
